response.original_title: ひまわり melodies: THE MOVIE  (A Conversation with God)
response.overview: Aitor is a hikikomori who lives on an island. In this movie, he’s interviewed by the god of the cosmos, Ken Matsuki. The little pervert has no idea what’s in wait for him: sunflowers, Jesus Christ, bears with hidden intentions and a seal that brings the end of the world! He meets a yakuza on the run for killing his boss’s newborn son, and he tries to start a new life as a rapper. Come and have fun at the Cosmic Circus Himawari Melodies!
response.tagline: Come and have fun at the Cosmic Circus Himawari Melodies!
